text:
maria: Quick profiling pass — noticed prefill queue latency climbing after the new fused-attn kernel landed. Prefill median p95 from 18ms -> 62ms.
ajay: ugh, saw same in dashboards. Is decode throughput affected or just prefill?
maria: Both. Prefill keeps growing which delays decode allocation; decode batches then end up using smaller kernels so throughput drops.
ryan: Any KV cache churn? I remember earlier kernel switch caused KV layout changes.
maria: Yes KV miss rate jumps ~3x during the spike. Logs:
```
2026-03-12T14:22:11Z [runtime] batch_allocate prefill=23 decode=4 kernel=fused-attn kv_hit=false
2026-03-12T14:22:11Z [runtime] prefiller enqueue_size=78 token_budget=512
```
jen: What are our token_budget targets per phase? We used 512 global earlier.
ajay: Right now it's a single token_budget per worker. That lets prefill consume too much when request mix skews.
maria: Proposal: split token budgets — budget_prefill=384, budget_decode=768 and enforce soft cap with backpressure + decode enqueue priority.
dave: How about kernel selection? We should avoid switching kernels mid-request. Maybe pin kernel family to the batch's phase (prefill vs decode).
ryan: Agree. Also add a fast-path for small decode batches to use int8-kernel and avoid fused-attn thrash.
ajay: Can we simulate with synthetic workload? I'll run the qps-replay with phase labels and the new budgets.
maria: Also add perf counters: kernel_switches_per_minute and kv_reorg_cycles so we can correlate.
perf-bot: Started replay job 4591 with params {mix: chat-heavy, duration: 15m} :rocket: 
ajay: Initial replay (2m bucket) looks promising — prefill p95 down to 22ms, KV misses back to baseline.
maria: Notes from the run: prefill queue length drop correlates with decode priority enforcement. Kernel_switches_per_minute reduced by ~40%.
jen: Let's land a small change: default split budgets + kernel-family pin. Rollout canary to 10% and watch kernel_switches_per_minute and prefill_queue_length.
dave: Add a fallback: if decode latency increases >20% during canary, revert kernel pin and increase decode budget.
ajay: I'll draft PR with microbench harness, replay results, and graphs (p95/kv_miss/kernel_switches).
ryan: Also update the batching docs with the new soft-cap heuristic and token budget tuning notes.
maria: Good. After canary we should add an alert: prefill_queue_length > 50 for >1m and kv_reorg_cycles spike > 5 -> paging oncall.
jen: Ack, I'll add the alert and a short runbook blurb.
ajay: PR queued, assigning reviewers @maria @ryan. :thumbsup:
